player_intent: Tap movement for a small slow peek step while leaning; hold movement to leave lean and travel normally.
acceptance_rule: Lean release remains latched; same-side press cancels and opposite switches. Movement under 0.22 seconds retains lean at at most 0.65 m/s, release stops immediately and resets the timer, continuous movement cancels lean at the hold threshold. Direction changes cannot reset the timer; diagonals cannot boost speed. Gravity/collision and prediction remain authoritative.

nodes.role: Owns lean intent, horizontal planting and collision movement.

visual_check: In main.tscn toggle Q/E, tap WASD for small slow steps with upper-body lean retained and lower-body locomotion active, release to plant, and hold WASD past 0.22s to exit lean. Check standing/crouched/prone and collision at an edge.

system_delta.reason: New user intent replaces movement-edge cancellation with timed tap/hold. Merge into the same CharacterBody solver and prediction codec; the existing posture consumer stops overwriting walking legs. No additional movement or bone owner.

current.system: Planted toggle cancels on fresh movement and overwrites legs with held pose

candidate.system: Timed micro steps with replayed hold timer and locomotion-owned legs
